prompt.project_info: Three-scene photorealistic gym fitness collection adapted from the source prompt and folder context.
prompt.main_subject: Scene one has two clearly adult original women: one blonde with a messy bun in a beige triangle sports bra and matching shorts with a soft smile, and one with dark wavy hair in a dark-gray scoop-neck sports bra and shorts leaning forward. Scene two has three clearly adult original women: one with long straight dark hair in a charcoal-gray deep-V set, one with blonde center-part waves in a beige set, and one with textured wet-look hair in a taupe bra and olive-green shorts. Scene three has three clearly adult original women: one with black hair in an updo with bangs wearing an all-black scoop-neck set and looking at a phone, one blonde in a beige triangle set, and one with a dark ponytail in an olive-green set leaning in.
prompt.composition_elements: Keep the three scenes separate: cool-lit gym with weight racks and mirrors; bright gym with cable machines and a waist-up mirror shot; and close-up gym with dumbbell racks. Preserve each scene's subject count, hair direction, clothing palette, sweat sheen and pose.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Cool gym lighting for scene one, bright even lighting for scene two and focused indoor gym light for scene three; candid post-workout energy with realistic sweat and natural expressions.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic fitness editorial collection, accurate mirror reflections, realistic sweat/fabric/hair texture, natural anatomy and distinct scene separation.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create three separate photorealistic gym scenes. Scene one: two clearly adult original women in a cool-lit gym with weight racks and mirrors, one blonde messy bun in a beige triangle sports set and one dark-wavy-haired woman in a dark-gray scoop-neck set. Scene two: three clearly adult original women in a bright cable-machine gym waist-up mirror shot, with long dark hair in charcoal gray, blonde waves in beige, and wet-look hair in taupe and olive green. Scene three: three clearly adult original women in a close-up gym with dumbbell racks, including black updo hair in an all-black set looking at a phone, blonde hair in beige and a dark ponytail in olive green leaning in; preserve sweat sheen, natural smiles and realistic reflections.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, celebrity likeness, biometric identity, transparent clothing, logos, text, watermark, duplicate subjects, merged limbs, broken reflections, plastic skin, extra fingers, deformed anatomy
